cases.input: Order line quantity 10 has line-bound fulfilment evidence for 6.
cases.expect: Delivered is 6 and outstanding is 4; invoice and payment facts remain independent.

cases.input: Invoice for quantity 10 is fully settled while only 6 were fulfilled.
cases.expect: Payment closes no fulfilment residual; outstanding remains 4.

cases.input: Accepted subscription order line pins an offer version and activates Subscription S v1.
cases.expect: Order line and subscription retain distinct identities and the line closes by activation, not shipment.

cases.input: S v1 is suspended mid-term and later reactivated.
cases.expect: Same immutable version remains; reversible suspension does not imply revocation or cancellation.

cases.input: Renewal selects a new offer price for the next term.
cases.expect: Successor subscription version pins the new offer; prior version and invoices remain unchanged; any proration is invoice-owned.

cases.input: A standalone Renewal identity is minted.
cases.expect: Rejected; renewal is a typed predecessor-successor link.

cases.input: Observed usage is treated as proof of entitlement.
cases.expect: Rejected; usage is externally mastered and creates no grant.

cases.input: Active subscription is treated as an independently keyed entitlement.
cases.expect: Rejected unless identityGate evidence proves a non-reconstructable grant.

cases.input: Grant is fully reconstructable from subscription version, offer item, beneficiary, period and source.
cases.expect: It remains a projection and receives no independent key.

cases.input: One subscription version grants separately suspended seat rights to different beneficiaries.
cases.expect: Recorded as evidence supporting but not automatically allocating an independent entitlement identity.

cases.input: A promotional consumption grant exists without a subscription.
cases.expect: Recorded as identityGate evidence; identifier remains unassigned pending registry adjudication.

cases.input: Prepaid remaining balance survives subscription cancellation.
cases.expect: Cancellation does not erase the candidate grant; evidence is preserved for boundary adjudication.

cases.input: A grant is transferred and split into a pooled balance with independent lineage.
cases.expect: Evidence supports independent lifecycle without changing allocation state.

cases.input: The profile stores authoritative remaining allowance.
cases.expect: Rejected as stealth mastership.

cases.input: The profile advances the subscription version head.
cases.expect: Rejected; WM-ECO-022 exclusively owns it.

cases.input: Profile records proration as its own state.
cases.expect: Rejected; economic consequence is materialized on WM-ECO-008 lines.

cases.input: Suspension permanently revokes the right and cancels the subscription.
cases.expect: Rejected; clocks and authorities are separate.

cases.input: Order or subscription references an offer name without version or valid time.
cases.expect: Rejected as non-reproducible.

cases.input: Deleting the profile deletes an order or subscription master.
cases.expect: Rejected; bindings never cascade-delete masters.

cases.input: A usage event is corrected after billing.
cases.expect: Correction remains WM-FLW-015-owned and triggers downstream recomputation without mutating entitlement or subscription history.

cases.input: Profile or candidate asserts payment allocation or residual.
cases.expect: Rejected; WM-ECO-009 owns allocation, residual and settlement exceptions.

cases.input: Grant is mastered by an external licence authority distinct from the commercial instrument.
cases.expect: Recorded as identityGate evidence; identifier remains unassigned.

cases.input: A second measurement model is cited for allowance projection.
cases.expect: Rejected; WM-FLW-015 is the sole usage authority.

cases.input: Binding cites a subscription without version, revision or as-of time.
cases.expect: Rejected as non-reproducible.

cases.input: UsageProjectionBinding omits as-of time.
cases.expect: Rejected.

cases.input: A binding is mutated instead of superseded.
cases.expect: Rejected; bindings are append-only.

cases.input: Overage or refund is held as profile or entitlement state.
cases.expect: Rejected; materialized on WM-ECO-008 lines.

cases.input: Successful service access is treated as proof of an active grant.
cases.expect: Rejected.

cases.input: Nonpayment suspends the subscription; grant restriction has a separate assertion, basis and effective time.
cases.expect: Only subscription suspension follows automatically; prior periods remain unchanged.

cases.input: Allowance-only change occurs, then subject changes.
cases.expect: Allowance change yields revision; subject change yields new candidate entitlement; history remains resolvable.

cases.input: Head and current revision disagree on permission, scope or period.
cases.expect: Rejected; terms are revision-mastered only.

cases.input: A retired entitlement identifier or revision number is reused.
cases.expect: Rejected; identifiers and revisions remain resolvable.

cases.input: Despatch evidence is admitted with no named master while WM-ECO-024 is unverified.
cases.expect: Blocked pending boundary adjudication.

cases.input: Candidate or profile asserts delivered, outstanding or allocated line quantity.
cases.expect: Rejected; WM-ECO-020 owns line quantity progress.

cases.input: One promotion evidence item is present.
cases.expect: Registry adjudication opens; allocationState remains unassigned.

predicates.P01: Profile mints no identity, lifecycle state, quantity, balance, version head or monetary consequence.
predicates.P02: WM-ECO-020 provisionally owns seller-side Order, OrderLine and line quantity progress under draft waiver; exclusivity is re-asserted only on base settlement.
predicates.P03: WM-ECO-022 provisionally owns Subscription identity, version chain, terms, suspension and renewal clocks under draft waiver; exclusivity is re-asserted only on base settlement.
predicates.P04: WM-ECO-021 owns the pinned offer or proposal version.
predicates.P05: WM-ECO-008 owns issued invoice, credit, debit, refund, overage and proration lines; profile stores no monetary-consequence state.
predicates.P06: WM-ECO-009 owns payment allocation, residual and settlement exceptions; payment is never a grant basis or state trigger.
predicates.P07: WM-FLW-015 owns actual usage events and corrections; usage never creates a grant.
predicates.P08: UsageProjectionBinding is correspondence-only, pins WM-FLW-015 usage stream identity plus as-of time and mints no balance.
predicates.P09: WM-ECO-020 is the provisional master of line-bound fulfilment evidence pending WM-ECO-024 adjudication; payment cannot change line residuals.
predicates.P10: Subscription-originating lines close by creating or activating a subscription version, not by shipment.
predicates.P11: RenewalAssertion is a read-only correspondence record of the WM-ECO-022-owned typed predecessor-to-successor link, pins both revisions, is never the sole renewal record and is never a type or model.
predicates.P12: One effective subscription version exists per instrument and instant; effective versions are immutable.
predicates.P13: Suspension is reversible and distinct from entitlement revocation, cancellation and termination.
predicates.P14: Paid, delivered, entitled and used remain independent claims with independent authority.
predicates.P15: Every binding pins source identity plus revision/version or valid/as-of time, is append-only with supersession and cannot be edited in place.
predicates.P16: Reconstructable grants remain projections; only identityGate evidence permits a future independent entitlement candidate.
predicates.P17: Profile cannot cascade-delete or mutate any upstream master.

allocationPredicates.A01: Order, line, subscription, entitlement, invoice, payment and usage observation retain distinct identities.
allocationPredicates.A02: Entitlement is bounded by subject, permission, scope and period and is never implied by active or paid subscription state.
allocationPredicates.A03: Every entitlement cites an authoritative grant basis and exact originating revision where applicable.
allocationPredicates.A04: Usage is measured externally and never mutates entitlement identity or issued revision.
allocationPredicates.A05: Remaining allowance is a projection over entitlement terms and qualified usage observations.
allocationPredicates.A06: Overage is a priced usage consequence and never silently expands entitlement allowance.
allocationPredicates.A07: Suspension, grace, revocation, cancellation, termination and expiry remain distinct states.
allocationPredicates.A08: Service availability and provisioning never prove that an entitlement is active.
allocationPredicates.A09: Material changes to scope, allowance, limits or period create immutable successor revisions or entitlements.
allocationPredicates.A10: Renewal links predecessor and successor entitlement or subscription versions and never rewrites prior terms.
allocationPredicates.A11: External grant or revocation execution records are evidence and never replace the governed entitlement transition.
allocationPredicates.A12: Retired entitlement identifiers and all prior revisions remain resolvable and are never recycled.
